terms.comment: No source has a word. Built like the household’s vestis nocturna (pyjamas), with nivālis, of snow (nivālis diēs, Liv. 21.54.7).

phrases.latin: Vestem nivālem indue, sī in nive lūdere vīs.
phrases.english: Put your snowsuit on if you want to play in the snow.

sources: Lewis & Short: vestis · Lewis & Short: nivalis
Traupman, Morgan–Owens and Levi–Bini have no word.
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
